description: Builds and reviews ACF PRO options pages and their global value storage. Covers acf_add_options_page registration, capabilities, menu and location rules, default and custom post_id prefixes in wp_options, hidden field-key references, autoload cost, frontend reads, field-name collisions, and migrations. Use when adding site-wide settings, header/footer content, brand configuration, or debugging options that leak between ACF options pages. Requires ACF PRO; reading ordinary WordPress options is outside this skill.
